description: Mandatory columns must not be NULL
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE AccountNumber IS NULL OR CustomerID IS NULL OR ProductCode IS NULL OR AccountStatus IS NULL OR Currency IS NULL OR AccountOpenDate IS NULL OR InterestRate IS NULL OR Balance IS NULL OR ValidFrom IS NULL OR ValidTo IS NULL OR LoadTimestamp IS NULL

description: ProductCode must be one of the allowed values: EASY_ACCESS, FIXED_1Y, NOTICE_90, ISA
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE ProductCode NOT IN ('EASY_ACCESS','FIXED_1Y','NOTICE_90','ISA') OR ProductCode = ''

description: AccountStatus must be one of the allowed values: OPEN, CLOSED, DORMANT, FROZEN
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE AccountStatus NOT IN ('OPEN','CLOSED','DORMANT','FROZEN') OR AccountStatus = ''

description: Currency must be non-null, length = 3 and equal to 'GBP'
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE Currency IS NULL OR LEN(Currency) <> 3 OR Currency <> 'GBP'

description: AccountNumber and CustomerID should have length <= 20 characters
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE (AccountNumber IS NOT NULL AND LEN(AccountNumber) > 20) OR (CustomerID IS NOT NULL AND LEN(CustomerID) > 20)
SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE InterestRate < 0.00 OR InterestRate >= 100.00 OR InterestRate IS NULL

description: Balance must be non-null; when AccountStatus = CLOSED Balance must equal 0.00
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE Balance IS NULL OR (AccountStatus = 'CLOSED' AND ISNULL(Balance,0.0) <> 0.00)

description: AccountMaturityDate must be non-null when ProductCode = FIXED_1Y, and when populated must be > AccountOpenDate
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE (ProductCode = 'FIXED_1Y' AND AccountMaturityDate IS NULL) OR (AccountMaturityDate IS NOT NULL AND AccountOpenDate IS NOT NULL AND AccountMaturityDate <= AccountOpenDate)

description: If AccountStatus = CLOSED then AccountCloseDate must be populated, >= AccountOpenDate and <= current date
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE AccountStatus = 'CLOSED' AND (AccountCloseDate IS NULL OR AccountOpenDate IS NULL OR AccountCloseDate < AccountOpenDate OR AccountCloseDate > GETUTCDATE())
SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE AccountOpenDate IS NOT NULL AND AccountOpenDate > GETUTCDATE()

description: ValidFrom must be <= ValidTo and ValidTo must be > ValidFrom; ValidTo and ValidFrom must be non-null
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE ValidFrom IS NULL OR ValidTo IS NULL OR ValidFrom > ValidTo OR ValidTo <= ValidFrom

description: Business key duplicate: AccountNumber + ValidFrom must be unique
rule_sql: SELECT a.* FROM curate.SavingsAccount a JOIN (SELECT AccountNumber, ValidFrom, COUNT(*) cnt FROM curate.SavingsAccount GROUP BY AccountNumber, ValidFrom HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) d ON a.AccountNumber = d.AccountNumber AND a.ValidFrom = d.ValidFrom

description: Exactly one current row (ValidTo = '9999-12-31') must exist per AccountNumber
rule_sql: SELECT AccountNumber, COUNT(*) current_count FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE ValidTo = '9999-12-31' GROUP BY AccountNumber HAVING COUNT(*) <> 1

description: No overlapping ValidFrom/ValidTo periods for the same AccountNumber (SCD2 ranges must not overlap)
rule_sql: SELECT a.* FROM curate.SavingsAccount a JOIN curate.SavingsAccount b ON a.AccountNumber = b.AccountNumber AND a.ValidFrom < b.ValidTo AND b.ValidFrom < a.ValidTo AND (a.ValidFrom <> b.ValidFrom OR a.ValidTo <> b.ValidTo)

description: LoadTimestamp must not be NULL and should be <= current system time
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE LoadTimestamp IS NULL OR LoadTimestamp > GETUTCDATE()
